title: Morning Brief — Saturday, 28 November 2026
description: Australia's unemployment rate climbs to a five-year high, Queensland releases a new ten-year plan to support volunteering ahead of the 2032 Games, and the Gold Coast Suns reshape their list with Scott Pendlebury among their trade period arrivals. 한국어 방송도 이어집니다.
